name: InPageNav
intro: Root receives the page headings. Put List and optional Heading inside it; Items can render links from the headings array.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns the heading list and active destination.

props.name: headings
props.description: Each heading has an anchor href, label, and depth from 1 through 6.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called when the active heading changes.

parts.name: Heading
parts.description: Displays a label for the navigation.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders links directly or from heading state.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Wrap one Link inside the list.

parts.name: Link
parts.description: Point href to a heading anchor on this page.

props.name: depth
props.description: Heading level used to style indentation.

parts.name: Scrollspy
parts.description: Observes heading intersections and updates the active destination.

parts.name: Items
parts.description: Renders Item and Link for each supplied heading.
